title: X11 selection clipboard readText returns empty immediately after writeText
body: On Linux/X11, clipboard.writeText('alpha', 'selection') completes but clipboard.readText('selection') immediately returns an empty string. The ordinary clipboard works. Expected: alpha.

title: Clipboard image loses alpha after writeImage
body: clipboard.writeImage(image) followed by clipboard.readImage() produces an opaque image; text and the selection clipboard work correctly.
